minor.issue: When no active drop exists, response is MISSING eligibility_status and compliance_text keys (spec requires them regardless of active drop). Currently only the active_drop branch emits these. Fix: also emit them in the early-return at line 3318-3324 of server.py.

ui_bugs.issue: my-won-reward only inspects lastDrop=history[0]; any subsequent drop with no winners (orphan-of-this-month) hides the user's prior win. Worker DOES have your_results for DROP-DC7703A546 (Grand Drop $100 approved) but UI shows empty because two newer test drops with empty your_results sit on top. Fix: render my-won-reward for the most recent drop where your_results.length > 0, or list all drops with wins.

action_items: Backend: /api/rewards/drop/current must include eligibility_status + compliance_text even when active_drop is None (spec requirement).

Frontend: Mobile.jsx drop-history-card — select lastWin = history.find(d => d.your_results?.length > 0) instead of lastDrop = history[0] when rendering my-won-reward, so user's past wins are not buried by newer empty drops.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3644 lines — well past 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, wallet, tier, node, admin, drops, apk).
Mobile.jsx is 909 lines — RewardsTab (lines 600-820) should be extracted to /components/RewardsTab.jsx.

The orphan-ticket auto-attach in /admin/drops/create is destructive across months: every time a new drop is created, ALL active-status tickets with draw_id=null get sucked into it. If an admin creates a new drop while a prior drop is still entries_closed/running, this is fine, but if tickets are intentionally being held back, there's no override.
Compliance copy 'Tickets cannot be purchased.' appears verbatim in 3 places (backend response, Mobile.jsx, Landing) — recommend centralizing as a constant.
/rewards/drop/current — no-active-drop branch loses eligibility_status & compliance_text (functional bug, listed above).

rca_of_the_issue: Two issues found, both with clear RCA: (1) /rewards/drop/current — at server.py line 3318 the `if not drop:` early-return only spreads `**elig` and adds note + lifetime_tgc_per_ticket, omitting `eligibility_status` and `compliance_text` which are added only at line 3345-3346 inside the active-drop branch. Fix: move both keys to a shared dict spread into both branches. (2) Mobile.jsx RewardsTab — line 671 `const lastDrop = history[0];` followed by line 773 `{lastDrop?.your_results?.length > 0 && ...}` means any newer drop with no user win blocks rendering of past wins. Fix: `const lastWin = history.find(d => (d.your_results || []).length > 0); lastDrop = lastWin || history[0];`. Both fixes are 1-2 line changes. No third-party / integration / library issues. No web search required.
